correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the exact minimal-fort types by the outside-neighbor definition, then considers the exhaustive case of no hub fort versus exactly one hub fort in a disjoint packing. Explicit pairings meet both bounds. Summed pair constraints yield a sharp fractional lower bound on every blade, and equality characterizes the complete optimal face, including all two-vertex blades. An explicit zero-forcing set meets the fort lower bound. Direct finite tests reconstruct original edges and all forts for 66 profiles; finite tests are supplementary, not a universal proof.

The 2023 fort-hypergraph LP paper and the September 2026 block-graph minimal-fort paper were compared to the actual implications, and no decisive coverage was found. Priority is provisional.

value.rationale: For the natural graph family comprising clique blades sharing a cut vertex, the exact packing and covering invariants and complete fractional optimizer-face geometry expose an unbounded additive gap and a sharp uniqueness transition. These are genuinely structural consequences over infinitely many unequal size profiles, not an arbitrary small-case computation or mere recounting of known minimal forts.
